summary: Backend-only verification of Phases 1-4 endpoints on Blue Collar Alpha. Created /app/backend/tests/test_phases_1_to_4.py with 19 pytest cases covering brokers CRUD, reconcile + cash-adjustments ledger, needs_reconcile flag lifecycle, /api/sentiment (premium + free 402), /api/coach/game-plan (premium + free 402), /api/insights/emotion, /api/insights/streak, and regression on /api/config and /api/gex. All 19 tests PASSED (100%). Sentiment returned live cards from Yahoo/alternative.me during the run. Game-plan LLM call succeeded and returned non-empty text with gex_levels. Reconcile without classification correctly defaulted to 'other'. needs_reconcile flipped to false after reconcile. Broker cleanup executed — all TEST_ brokers deleted after run.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1894 lines — recommend future split into modules (auth, brokers, sentiment, coach, gex) for maintainability.
In /api/brokers/reconcile, iterating over items issues one insert + one update per item without a bulk write; acceptable at current scale but worth noting for high-volume users.
_sentiment_cache is a module-level dict without locking — potential (minor) race under concurrent premium requests; acceptable because worst case is an extra upstream fetch.
Sentiment endpoint quietly omits any card whose upstream call errors — verified this behavior is intentional and the endpoint contract still holds.
seed_data_creation: Created and then DELETED two TEST_ broker_accounts for premium user stocktradesrvl@gmail.com during the run. Cash_adjustments docs (win + other) remain in the ledger for that user — these are intentional per request ('creating brokers writes to broker_accounts/cash_adjustments … that's fine, but note it'). Also registered a fresh TEST_free_<random>@example.com user each run to verify 402 gating; these free users remain in users collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_phases_1_to_4.py is reusable. It logs in as premium (stocktradesrvl@gmail.com/TradeAdmin123), creates two TEST_ brokers, reconciles, verifies cash-adjustments summary, deletes brokers, then hits sentiment/game-plan/emotion/streak. Free user gating verified via freshly-registered TEST_free_*@example.com (email validator rejects .local TLDs). All 19 tests pass in ~12s. Regressions on /api/config and /api/gex also verified. Deprecated packages / RN issues not applicable (backend-only scope).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no failures. Only minor test-infra issue encountered: email-validator library rejects @bca.local as reserved TLD; switched fresh-user emails to @example.com.
